- When sentiment is negative (≤ 0.06) in recent days, model tends to overcorrect upward; reduce forecast peak by 5–10%.
- After a sharp price spike (forecast > 75), model often overshoots; cap next 3–5 days’ forecast at +5% below peak.
- If sentiment shows strong bullish momentum (≥ 0.17) but price drops, model underreacts; adjust downward by 2–5% of recent drop.
- Mean reversion bias: if 3–5 consecutive forecasts are above 72, reduce by 1–3% per day until price stabilizes.
- Forecast horizon 30d: if true outcome is consistently 5–10% below forecast, reduce next 10d forecast by 2–4% to align with recent mean.
- Lagged sentiment: if sentiment was negative 3–5 days ago, model often overreacts; apply 1–2% downward bias to 30d forecast.
